column1: # The system layer of the test modules of every crate under crates/ (the deterministic test layer
# One row per module that reaches a source a unit test may not: kind pending is owed a move to the
# simulated world and its row goes when it moves; kind system has the host as its subject. The
# gate holds each row to the sources its module reaches, both ways. Every crate is covered: the
# rows of each crate's first day are every module of it that reached a source then (the gate's
# --rows), and a row is added after that only for a module whose subject is the host.
